raw_sections.education:
EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:
Completed Graduation in Computer Science & Engineering from JNTUK.
Project: Creative: AI-Powered Visual Generation for Marketing  
Organization: Lavu Tech Solutions Sdn Bhd                                                                                                                                      
Client:  Advertising and Branding Firm: HAVAS GROUP (Jan 2024- till date)
Developed a GenAI-based system using OpenAI’s CLIP, Taming Transformers, and Stable Diffusion to generate high-quality, customized images from user prompts for use in advertisements and branding. Automated creative workflows, enabling rapid iteration and personalization of visuals.
Key Achievements:
Enabled real-time generation of marketing visuals from text prompts, reducing production time.
Integrated CLIP and Stable Diffusion for accurate, high-quality, and creative outputs.
Provided scalable solutions for ad agencies to create dynamic, contextually relevant images, helping boost campaign effectiveness.
Project: Price Pulse –Competitor Pricing & Stock Monitoring 
Organization: Lavu Tech Solutions Sdn Bhd
Client: Walmart (March 2022- Jan 2024)
Developed a cloud-based system to track competitor pricing and stock data in real-time. Extracted and stored data from retail websites, visualized insights via a Streamlit dashboard, and enabled dynamic pricing strategies.
Key Achievements:
Enabled real-time SKU price benchmarking and inventory risk alerts (15–20% stockout reduction).
Improved pricing strategy and customer retention through predictive analytics.
Automated decision-making, replacing manual tracking with data-driven insights.
Delivered conversational access to pricing intelligence using the RAG pipeline, improving adoption by non-technical teams.
Project: Smart Casting Inspection:
Organization: Optimum Solutions Pte Ltd.
Client: Siemen (July 2021 – Feb 2022)
Automated the quality control process for detecting surface defects in metal casting products, including pump impellers and motor housings. Designed the system to reduce human error, optimize inspection workflows, and ensure consistent delivery of high-quality products through the production line.
Key Achievements & Business Value:
Achieved 93.5% validation accuracy with a 27% reduction in false negatives using transfer learning and data augmentation techniques (rotation, zoom, flip).
Reduced manual inspection effort by ~1,200 hours/year, enabling $80K annual cost savings through improved efficiency and consistency.
Deployed as a Streamlit web app for real-time image-based predictions; packaged with Docker and hosted on AWS EC2 for easy access on the factory floor.
Project: Consumer Interaction Trend Assessment: 
Organization: Wipro
Client: Amwell (Oct 2019 – May 2021)
Leveraged data retrieval and generation methods to extract actionable insights, facilitating rapid identification of customer concerns. Delivered strategic recommendations that improved service delivery, enhanced customer satisfaction, and optimized operational efficiency. Integrated the system into real-time workflows, enabling prompt detection of trends and issues for timely resolution.
Key Achievements & Business Value:
Streamlit offers an intuitive interface, enhancing user experience.
BERT-based models help healthcare providers like Amwell gain deeper insights into patient sentiments, improving satisfaction and care outcomes.
By analysing feedback, Amwell can identify pain points and areas of improvement in their services, leading to better patient satisfaction.
Project: Predictive Model for Flight and Hotel Pricing Optimization.
Organization: Wipro
Client: Expedia (Aug 2017 – Oct 2019)
Developed a machine learning-based predictive model to forecast flight and hotel prices, as well as customer booking behaviour, to optimize dynamic pricing and resource allocation at Expedia. The solution used historical booking data to predict demand and pricing trends, enabling personalized recommendations and improved operational efficiency.
Key Responsibilities & Business Value:
Cleaned and transformed large datasets, handling missing values, encoding categorical variables, and scaling features.
Built and trained multiple machine learning models (Linear Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost) to predict flight prices, hotel availability, and customer booking likelihood.
Evaluated models using metrics such as Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and accuracy. Optimized the models to improve prediction accuracy by up to 15%.
Created an interactive Streamlit app to enable real-time price and booking predictions for business users.
Dynamic pricing adjustments based on demand predictions led to a 20% revenue increase during peak periods.
Personalized recommendations boosted conversion rates by 15%.
Improved resource allocation, reducing overbookings by 10% and optimizing marketing spend with a 18% higher ROI.
